```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(p8105.datasets)
library(tidyverse)
library(leaflet)
data(nyc_airbnb)
```

## Some questions
* where are the most expensive airbnbs in nyc?
* which neighbourhood has the highest concentration?
* which one is the cheapest?
* which airbnb hosts are most/ best reviewed?
* has the number increased / decreased over time?


```{r}
nyc_airbnb =
  nyc_airbnb |> 
  mutate(stars = review_scores_location / 2)
```

```{r}
nyc_airbnb |> 
  count(room_type, neighbourhood_group) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = room_type,
    values_from = n
  )
```

```{r}
nyc_airbnb |> 
  filter(neighbourhood_group == "Manhattan") |> 
  count(room_type, neighbourhood_group) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = room_type,
    values_from = n
  )
```

## price

```{r}
nyc_airbnb |> 
  group_by(neighbourhood_group) |> 
  mutate(price_rank = min_rank(desc(price))) |> 
  filter(price_rank < 2)
```

```{r}
nyc_airbnb |> 
  filter(price < 1000) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = price)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  facet_grid(room_type ~ neighbourhood_group)
```

prices on average

```{r}
nyc_airbnb |> 
  group_by(room_type, neighbourhood_group) |> 
  summarize(
    mean_price = mean(price)
  ) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = room_type,
    values_from = mean_price
  )
```

```{r}
nyc_airbnb |> 
  filter(neighbourhood_group == "Manhattan") |> 
  filter(price < 500) |> 
  filter(room_type != "Shared room") |> 
  mutate(neighbourhood == fct_reorder(neighbourhood, price)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = neighbourhood, y = price)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_grid(. ~ room_type) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```



## host

```{r}
nyc_airbnb |> 
  filter(calculated_host_listings_count > 10)
```

## visualise price

```{r}
nyc_airbnb |> 
  filter(neighbourhood_group == "Manhattan") |> 
  filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt") |> 
  filter(price < 500) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = lat, y = long, color = price)) +
  geom_point(alpha = .5)
```

## leaflet map

```{r}
pal = colorNumeric(
  palette = "viridis",
  domain = 1:500
)

nyc_airbnb |> 
  filter(neighbourhood_group == "Manhattan") |> 
  filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt") |> 
  filter(price < 500) |> 
  #sample_n(50) |> 
  leaflet() |> 
  addTiles() |> 
  addCircleMarkers(~lat, ~long, color = ~pal(price), radius = .5)
```
